note: Silhouette scores compare visible boundaries only, not internal geometry, wood, lighting or unseen surfaces. Original controls overall proportions; the accepted side guide directs the head/button join.

internal_features.inspection: Original and selected overlays plus true level head profiles checked against neutral render; topology, junction surface and slit depth independently validated.
internal_features.mitre: Continuous curved head with a full-thickness oblique slit. The declared semicircular floor replaces the earlier flat termination; solid wood remains below it. Width, angle and the original edge bevel are preserved.
internal_features.finial: Shallower rounded button with a thin underside; its front rim is fitted independently of shading. The head tip enters directly with measured broad contact and no exposed neck. Physical height and radii are preserved.
internal_features.collars: All collar controls retain the preceding accepted checkpoint; collar face and underside curvature remain under examination.
internal_features.lower_body: The lower body and current straight-foot-wall correction are unchanged. No socket, stem, flare or foot edits are part of the button refit.
internal_features.limits: The accepted side guide is art direction, not a recovered source camera. Boxwood pigment, surface relief and reflections are an unfinished reconstruction. Single-view evidence cannot determine hidden geometry uniquely. The retained pigment and lights have not been refitted to this geometry; neutral comparison is required.
